steps.subject: sky
steps.action: start sky with indian yellow and bright red
steps.load: mix them together on the brush
steps.motion: criss-cross strokes, back and forth

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: mix lavender for the sky
steps.load: mostly crimson with a little blue
steps.motion: add lavender here and there, without cleaning
steps.rule: lavender between colors acts as a barrier

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: fill sky with midnight black and prussian blue
steps.load: a tiny touch of prussian blue in the black
steps.motion: back and forth, barely grazing the canvas

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the whole sky with a clean dry brush
steps.load: clean dry brush
steps.motion: blend all the colors together

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lay in a small distant mountain
steps.load: cut a tiny roll of blue and black
steps.motion: drop it in, far back

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lay in a big dark mountain
steps.load: dark purplish mix with a little van dyke brown, cut a little roll
steps.motion: drop in the basic mountain shape

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the big brush down and blend the mountain out
steps.motion: pull it down and let it blend out

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: shadow ideas with lavender and blue
steps.load: cut a tiny bit of lavender with a little blue
steps.motion: put in basic little shadow shapes
steps.where: small shadow spot on the mountain

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: warm mix of bright red, lavender and yellow ochre
steps.load: take bright red, add lavender and yellow ochre
steps.motion: place little shapes, do not overmix

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: work dark sienna into the mix
steps.load: add some dark sienna, work back and forth
steps.motion: let the colors play, blend a little

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: dark strokes for a bump on the mountain
steps.load: cut a little of the dark mix
steps.motion: flow a few strokes down
steps.rule: dark goes in first so the light shows when placed on it

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: small shadows
steps.load: blue, purplish tone, white, more blue
steps.motion: put shadows in, coming straight down
steps.rule: a small knife gets into tight areas more easily

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap with a clean dry brush and pull color down the angles
steps.load: clean dry brush
steps.motion: tap, pick up color and follow the angles down

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: sparkle of titanium white flowing down into the misty area
steps.load: take a little white on the brush
steps.motion: tap and let it flow down

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lightly tap and lift upward with clean dry brush
steps.load: clean dry brush
steps.motion: lightly tap and lift upward
steps.where: here and there on the mountain

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap a black and blue shadow around the shape
steps.load: a little black and blue on the brush
steps.motion: tap, pick up and bring it around

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: blend lightly to create the illusion of mist
steps.load: tap a little blue in
steps.motion: blend lightly, not caring where it goes
steps.rule: a light blend gives the illusion of mist

steps.subject: water
steps.action: drop in little water indications
steps.load: a tiny bit of blue and yellow
steps.motion: drop in little indications, leaving a few open
steps.rule: blue meeting yellow turns greenish, which is allowed here

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap lavender trees in the distance and pull reflections down
steps.load: tap lavender into the bristles
steps.motion: tap a few trees, then pull straight down
steps.where: distant trees, then reflections below them
steps.rule: wet canvas makes reflections easy to pull

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tiny touch of sap green and cad yellow on far trees
steps.load: same brush, lightly cleaned
steps.motion: tap a tiny bit
steps.rule: too much detail would ruin the illusion of distance

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add a little more detail to closer trees
steps.load: same brush
steps.motion: add a few marks and a tree coming down
steps.where: closer trees, one on the right

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: thin liquid white water lines with the knife
steps.load: liquid white with a little blue on the knife
steps.motion: cut across and drop straight water lines
steps.rule: thin paint sticks to thick paint, so it flows on top

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: big tree trunk with arms in dark sienna
steps.load: dark sienna on the knife
steps.motion: pull up the trunk and give it strong arms
steps.where: big tree in the upper area
steps.rule: the tree needs arms to reach for the sun

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dark bottom of the trees, lighter going up
steps.load: browns, a little black, sap green
steps.motion: pull it down and let it lighten upward
steps.rule: the biggest shadows hide at the bottom of trees and bushes

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull reflections down from the tree
steps.load: same mix
steps.motion: pull straight down into the water

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: curved trunk and red-brown highlights
steps.load: red-brown mix with a little white, cut across
steps.motion: curve the trunk, then lay highlights with the knife edge

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin liquid black limbs with a liner
steps.load: liquid black thinned with paint thinner to a point
steps.motion: pull limb indications, turning the brush

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: dab small branches with liquid white
steps.load: a little liquid white on the cleaned brush
steps.motion: dab on small branches
steps.rule: a dirty brush works best for scattered branches

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab leaves in yellow, ochre and red
steps.load: a little cad yellow, yellow ochre, bright red on the brush
steps.motion: tap and drop in leaves
steps.rule: a little liquid white or thinner helps the paint stick

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: 1in brush sap green and yellow highlights
steps.load: liquid white, then a full load of yellows and green
steps.motion: pull in one direction, load full

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: dark evergreen with brown, black and green
steps.load: load the brush full of brown, black and green
steps.motion: push the evergreen out of the brush

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: lighter green highlights on the evergreen
steps.load: lighter green on the same brush
steps.motion: tap a few little highlights
steps.where: on the evergreen, and a friend beside it

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: stones in browns
steps.load: browns on the round brush
steps.motion: plop them in as stones of different sizes

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: liquid white water line through the land
steps.load: liquid white on the brush
steps.motion: run it right down through the land
steps.rule: the line cleans up the scene

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: 1in yellows and greens, add leaves
steps.load: yellows and greens on the brush
steps.motion: pop in little leaves

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: fan brush, two big trees in van dyke brown
steps.load: load the fan full of van dyke brown
steps.motion: drop in big trees, deciding where they live
steps.where: two big trees, one over the mountain

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: knife highlights on the big trees, with reflected blue
steps.load: same highlight color
steps.motion: bounce lightly on the tree
steps.where: highlights on the big trees, plus a little blue on one side

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin liquid black limbs with paint thinner
steps.load: liquid black with paint thinner
steps.motion: drop a few limbs off the tree

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap leaf highlights with the 2in brush
